methods.what: Definition of coefficients alpha, beta, gamma as quotients of products of theta functions with shifted characteristics
Expressing linear combinations of x, y, z as products of theta functions
Quartic theta relation (difference of two products of four thetas equals a product of four thetas)
Sum of three square roots of quadratic forms (equation of a curve/quartic) and its restriction to x=0 to determine ratio y/z
